profile.headline: Software Engineer (React.js/Django 4/FastAPI)
profile.summary:
I am a fast learner and a team player as a software engineer. I am committed to delivering quality, well-designed software solutions that meet the users' needs. I am also passionate about using technology to solve real-world problems and positively impact society. I believe these qualities make me a strong candidate for software engineering roles.

I am a graduate of Hack Reactor, where I gained hands-on experience in modern web development technologies, including React.js and Redux for the front end, FastAPI and Django for the back end, and PostgresSQL for database management. In my free time, I enjoy playing games and connecting with people. I am always eager to learn and constantly improve my skills.

Front-End | React.js, Redux, Bootstrap, DOM manipulation, Websockets, SASS
Back-End | Django 4, PostgreSQL, FastAPI, RabbitMQ, JSON
Programming | Python, JavaScript ES6+, CSS, HTML5, GitLab, Docker
System Design | Monoliths, Microservices, Domain-Driven Design

positions.title: Contact Center Specialist
positions.locationName: College Station, Texas, United States · On-site
positions.description: This role is responsible for providing front-line support to patients through inbound phone calls, emails, and electronic requests. This includes answering questions, providing technical support, registering new patients, scheduling healthcare appointments, handling complaints, and providing information on behalf of the institution. I have excellent listening, communication, and interpersonal skills, as well as strong data entry, numeric, typing, and computer navigational skills. I am comfortable working in a fast-paced, constantly changing, and potentially stressful environment.

projects.title: Mix'n Dash
projects.description:
Mix'n Dash is a web application that aims to improve communication and booking processes for hosts and bartenders. The application was built using React.js, Redux, React Hooks, FastAPI, and PostgreSQL. Custom API endpoints were also developed to enable seamless communication between the various components of the application.

The development of Mix'n Dash was a team effort, involving four software engineers who used git management services to collaborate on the project. The application was then deployed to a cloud provider using continuous integration, ensuring that any updates or changes to the code base were automatically deployed to the live application.

Overall, Mix'n Dash provides hosts and bartenders with an easy-to-use platform for managing bookings and communicating with each other, streamlining the process and making it more efficient.
